patches.adaptation: Omit third_party/zstd/BUILD.gn hunk: existing control port already sets ZSTD_DISABLE_ASM at the start of decompress. Applying it twice makes GN reject a nonempty-list replacement.

patches.origin: Local compatibility fix for Chromium140 content_shell test harness: restrict MSVC warning suppression to is_msvc.
Local compatibility definition for missing MinGW userenv.h profile flag, preserving profile classification.

Local fixes so content_shell builds in Qt's tree with GCC: test support adapted to Qt's backported interfaces, MinGW header gaps (crashpad minidump types, swdevice, DEVPROPERTY), MSVC-only libs/flags/ATL/WRL kept to MSVC, WebRTC and screen capture off, -municode windowed entry, -lfoo.lib rewritten by the link wrapper, protobuf tolerating a mismatched system upb.

Restores Chromium's own Windows platform layer that QtWebEngineCore normally replaces: aura content views, WinWindow, WinCursorFactory, a ScreenWin for the aura-only shell, resource bundle, pointer devices, font list, Vulkan factory, upstream viz output devices and variations. ATL/OLE/Qt-header pieces use Chromium's generic implementations (non-backed clipboard and drag data, non-platform accessibility).
